## Overview

The `akashic.civics` R package provides statistical methods for criminal justice
disparity analysis. It includes functions for:

- Descriptive statistics and disparity computation
- Hypothesis testing (Z-tests, t-tests)
- OLS and logistic regression
- Doubly-robust causal estimation
- Adaptive disconfirmation testing
- Multi-jurisdiction comparison

## Getting Started

```{r}
library(akashic.civics)
```

## Descriptive Statistics

```{r}
# Create sample case data
cases <- data.frame(
  race_ethnicity = rep(c("White", "Black", "Hispanic"), each = 100),
  conviction = c(rbinom(100, 1, 0.60),
                 rbinom(100, 1, 0.75),
                 rbinom(100, 1, 0.65)),
  sentence_months = c(rnorm(100, 24, 12),
                      rnorm(100, 36, 18),
                      rnorm(100, 30, 15))
)

# Compute descriptive statistics
stats <- compute_descriptive_stats(cases)
print(stats)
```

## Hypothesis Testing

```{r}
# Z-test comparing two proportions
result <- run_z_test(0.60, 100, 0.75, 100)
print(result)
```

## Regression Analysis

```{r}
# OLS regression
ols_result <- run_ols_regression(cases,
                                 outcome_col = "sentence_months",
                                 predictors = c("race_ethnicity"))
print(ols_result)
```

## Causal Inference

```{r}
# Doubly-robust estimation
cases$treatment <- rbinom(nrow(cases), 1, 0.5)
dr_result <- run_doubly_robust(cases,
                                treatment_col = "treatment",
                                outcome_col = "sentence_months",
                                covariates = c("race_ethnicity"))
print(dr_result)
```

## Multi-Jurisdiction Comparison

```{r}
cases$jurisdiction_id <- rep(c("CityA", "CityB", "CityC"), each = 100)
comparison <- compare_jurisdictions(cases,
                                     outcome_col = "sentence_months",
                                     group_col = "race_ethnicity",
                                     jurisdiction_col = "jurisdiction_id")
print(comparison$summary)
```

## Export Results

```{r}
export_results(comparison, format = "json", file = "comparison.json")
```
